distribuicao.actualizada_faltam_other: Location updated. {{count}} units still to be located.

movimentos.erro_operacao: An error occurred during the operation.

lista.comprometido_excede: Committed exceeds the warehouse balance — check
lista.filtro_stock_baixo: Showing only the locations below the defined minimum.
lista.zero_escondidas: Locations at zero are hidden, except those with a minimum defined.
lista.vazio_tudo_reposto: No products below the defined minimum. Everything is restocked.
lista.vazio_sem_stock: No products with stock. Turn on “Show products with no stock” to see the locations at zero.

detalhe.sem_movimentos: No movements recorded for this stock.

modal_mov.so_uma_posicao: This product only has a location in this warehouse. Create the product in another warehouse so you can transfer.
modal_mov.placeholder_motivo: Describe the reason for this movement...

inventario.nenhum_ciclo_dica: Create a new cycle to start the stock count.
inventario.ciclo_em_estado: The cycle "{{nome}}" is {{estado}}. Wait for the manager to start the count.
inventario.sem_ciclo_em_andamento: There is no stock count cycle in progress. Wait for the manager to open a cycle.

novo_ciclo.nome_dica: It will be visible to operators during the count.
novo_ciclo.armazem_dica: All goods already assigned to a shelf in this warehouse enter the cycle as pending.
novo_ciclo.localizacoes_ok: {{n}} location(s) registered. Check that goods are assigned to them on each stock location's record.
novo_ciclo.sem_localizacoes: This warehouse has no locations (shelves) registered yet.
novo_ciclo.erro_criar: Error creating the cycle. Please try again.

ciclo.reconciliado_ok: Reconciled. No discrepancy exceeded the tolerance.
ciclo.ajuda_preparado: Scope loaded. Start the count so operators can record products.
ciclo.ajuda_em_contagem_pendentes: Count in progress. {{n}} product(s) still to be checked.
ciclo.ajuda_em_contagem_completa: All products have been checked. You can move on to validate coverage.
ciclo.ajuda_pausado: Cycle paused. Resume to continue the count.
ciclo.ajuda_validacao: Validating coverage — move on to reconcile.
ciclo.ajuda_reconciliacao: Run the reconciliation to compare physical with theoretical stock.
ciclo.ajuda_recontagem: There are items pending a blind recount.
ciclo.ajuda_ajuste_aprovado: All exceptions have been decided and the stock adjustments have been written. The cycle just needs to be closed.
ciclo.erro_concluir_antes: Complete all products before finishing the stock count.

contagem.cego_texto: The system does not show the theoretical quantities. Count what is physically there.
contagem.por_verificar: {{n}} product(s) still to be checked. Complete all products before finishing the stock count.
contagem.sem_perimetro: No items in scope to identify the warehouse
contagem.seleccione_produto: Select a product from the list to record the count.

contagem_item.confirmar_zero: Confirm that you have checked the whole location before recording zero.
contagem_item.unidade_cega: Unit: {{unidade}} — the system balance is deliberately not shown (blind count).

atribuir.subtitulo: Only the chosen operator will be able to start counting these locations (§8).

fecho.encerrado: Cycle closed. The stock adjustments and expenses have been posted.
fecho.nao_pode_fechar: This cycle is not in a condition to be closed directly (current status:
fecho.explicacao: This shortcut skips the recount and the exceptions queue — use it when the discrepancies are small and do not justify all that work.
fecho.lancado_despesa: Posted as an expense on closing

historico_contagem.vazio: There are no changes recorded for this item yet.

inesperado.registado: Unexpected product recorded — it stays on the list for the manager to investigate.
inesperado.subtitulo: It was not expected in this stock count — it is recorded for investigation.

tolerancias.subtitulo: Without a tolerance, any discrepancy triggers a recount (§10).
tolerancias.nenhuma: No tolerance configured — every discrepancy triggers a recount.

recontagem.sem_pendentes_texto: All the discrepancies in this cycle have been recounted or did not exceed the tolerance.
recontagem.confirmada: Recount recorded — the discrepancy was confirmed and moves on to analysis.
recontagem.bate_certo: Recount recorded — the value matches what was expected.
recontagem.cega_texto: You only see the product, photo and location — never the theoretical stock, the first count or the discrepancy.

excecao.erro_mayra: Could not get the classification from MAYRA.
excecao.rejeitar_exige_motivo: Rejecting an adjustment requires a reason.
excecao.ruptura_comprar: Stock-out risk: no warehouse has a surplus — consider buying {{n}} unit(s).
excecao.so_por_decidir: Show only those awaiting a decision
excecao.movimentos_durante: {{n}} stock movement(s) during the count — the discrepancy may reflect a concurrent sale/goods receipt rather than a real loss (§9).
excecao.ruptura_comprar_linha: Stock-out risk — no other warehouse has a surplus; consider buying {{n}} unit(s).
excecao.critico_obrigatoria: Classified as critical — a human decision is mandatory.

EXCESSO.label: Overstock
EXCESSO.descricao: Sells, but there is too much stock

OBSOLETO.label: Obsolete
OBSOLETO.descricao: No demand for a long time

RISCO_VALIDADE.label: Expiry risk
RISCO_VALIDADE.descricao: Has an expiry date — act now or lose it

leitor.sem_camara_dica: Type the barcode in the field below. On a mobile phone, scanning with the camera becomes available.
leitor.aponte: Point the camera at the product barcode.

fefo.explicacao: The batch that expires soonest comes first (FEFO). Expired and blocked batches never enter the recommendation — they appear separately, with the reason.
fefo.nenhum_lote: No eligible batch. Either there are no batches recorded for this product in this warehouse, or the ones that exist are expired or blocked.
fefo.faltam_depois: with no batch available. The eligible batches do not cover the quantity requested.
fefo.nao_abate: This is a picking recommendation: it does not deduct stock. The choice of batch at sale and picking is not yet made by the system, so whoever picks has to follow these lines manually.

localizacao.excede_saldo: The locations add up to more than the warehouse balance. Some goods-out did not go through the shelves — recount and correct.
localizacao.sem_posicoes: This warehouse has no locations defined.
localizacao.sem_posicoes_dica: Create them in the warehouse's “Locations” tab, under Stores → Warehouses.
localizacao.nenhuma_atribuida: No location assigned — it is known to be in this warehouse, but not on which shelf.
localizacao.nota_antes: The quantity is what is in
localizacao.nota_depois: location, and it replaces what was recorded there — type what you counted, not the difference. Setting it to zero removes the assignment. This does not generate a stock movement: the goods do not leave the warehouse.
localizacao.sem_existencias: This product has no stock in any warehouse.
localizacao.sem_posicao_neste_armazem: {{n}} {{unidade}} with no location assigned in this warehouse.
localizacao.mover_entre_armazens: To move goods between warehouses use a stock transfer — that is a goods-out and a goods-in, and it generates a movement. Here you can only view.

RESERVAR.explicacao: The goods stay in the warehouse and still count in the stock count, but are no longer available for another order. It does not generate a stock movement.

QUARENTENA.explicacao: For goods received awaiting approval, or that need analysis. They leave the available stock without leaving the warehouse.

BLOQUEIO.explicacao: For goods that must not leave by decision: a dispute with the supplier, a suspected quality issue, a customer's goods. Different from quarantine, which is a stage of goods receipt.

LIBERTAR_QUARENTENA.explicacao: Analysis complete and goods approved: they return to available stock. To REJECT goods, release them and then record the goods-out as a negative adjustment — a rejection is a stock exit, not a release, and confusing the two would leave too much stock in the system.

LIBERTAR_BLOQUEIO.explicacao: The reason for the block no longer applies. The goods return to available stock and can be sold.

retencao.excede_retidas: Only {{n}} {{unidade}} are held — there is nothing more to release.
retencao.excede_disponiveis: Only {{n}} {{unidade}} are available. The rest is in the warehouse but committed.
retencao.referencia_dica: The order that originated the reservation. Without this, a reservation found two weeks from now cannot be explained to anyone.
retencao.sem_prazo_dica: For goods already picked and waiting for collection, where expiring on its own would return to available stock boxes that are on a pallet at the door.
retencao.caduca_dica: Empty uses 48 hours. Once the deadline passes, the goods return to available stock automatically.
retencao.motivo_dica: Goods held without a reason are released by no one, for fear of undoing a decision nobody knows the reason for.

reservas_tab.vazio_activa: No active reservations — all the stock in the warehouse is available.
reservas_tab.nota: Reserving is not selling: the goods stay in the warehouse and still count in the stock count, but leave available stock and cannot be sold at the POS. None of these operations generates a stock movement, because the physical stock never changes.

validade.bloqueado_titulo: Blocked batch: keeps its balance but is not recommended for picking
validade.sem_registo_one: {{count}} product requires an expiry date and has no batch recorded.
validade.sem_registo_other: {{count}} products require an expiry date and have no batch recorded.
validade.sem_registo_detalhe: These goods are not monitored. The expiry date is entered at goods receipt — later receipts will require it, but the stock already here still has no known expiry.
validade.criterios: Risk from {{risco}} days · warning at {{aviso}} (or whatever the product defines)
validade.vazio: No batch in this status. If the stock has no batches recorded, the expiry is not monitored — record it at goods receipt.
validade.nota: The system recommends picking from the batch that expires first (FEFO), but it does not yet prevent the sale of out-of-date goods — the choice of batch at sale is not made automatically. To remove expired goods from stock, use a negative adjustment.

saude.sem_venda_ha_mais: no sales for more than {{n}} days
saude.rast_titulo: The value at expiry risk is a minimum, not a total.
saude.rast_a: Only {{pct}}% of the stock is covered by batches with a recorded expiry date
saude.rast_b_one: , and {{count}} product requires an expiry date but has no batch recorded
saude.rast_b_other: , and {{count}} products require an expiry date but have no batch recorded
saude.rast_c: . Only what is recorded at goods receipt is monitored.
saude.lim_nota: These thresholds are a business matter, not a code matter: 60 days without a sale is normal in an electrical appliance shop and an alarm in a grocery. The change applies to the analysis immediately.
saude.vazio_classe: No products in the {{classe}} class with the current thresholds.
saude.nota_sazonal: A stagnant product may be seasonal — demand concentrated in one period of the year. Before deciding to clear it, check the history for the same period in previous years. This analysis quantifies the problem; it does not recommend the action.
